{{Quote|The Empire owes you much. Our victory would not be possible without you. What reward would you name?''"<br />"''Your life, Emperor Fel.|Roan Fel's double and Darth Krayt|<ref name="Legacy 1" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|man]] served as the '''double''' of [[Roan Fel]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] of the [[Fel Empire]], in [[130 ABY]]. He was with Fel on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] several days after the Empire [[Battle of Caamas|defeated]] the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] in the [[Sith–Imperial War]] and won control of the galaxy. When Fel learned that his [[One Sith|Sith]] allies were planning to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him and usurp his throne, he arranged for his double to appear at a meeting of the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]] in order to trick the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and allow Fel to flee into [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]]. Four [[Imperial Knight]]s flanked the double at the meeting, which was interrupted by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]]. Krayt demanded the life of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and [[Attack on Emperor Fel|struck down]] all four Imperial Knights before killing the double and seizing the throne.

==Biography==
{{Quote|They'll expect me&mdash;and a contingent of Imperial Knights&mdash;to appear at the council&hellip;''"<br />"''I'll lead them&mdash;and your double.|Roan and Mohrgan Fel|<ref name="Legacy 8">[[Legacy (2006) 8|''Legacy'' (2006) 8]]</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|man]] served the [[Fel Empire]] in [[130 ABY]]<ref name="LECG" /> as a security double of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|260|Fel, Roan}}</ref> His appearance was nearly identical to that of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]].<ref name="Legacy 1" /> In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the Empire [[Battle of Caamas|defeated]] the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] in the [[Sith–Imperial War]] and gained control of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Fel moved his headquarters from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] to the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and his double was with him on the capital world several days later. The Emperor learned that his [[One Sith|Sith]] allies planned to betray him and usurp his throne, and he accordingly arranged for his double to appear at a scheduled meeting of the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]] later in the day. He hoped the ruse would allow him to escape the planet, and his cousin, the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Mohrgan Fel]], volunteered to lead [[Unidentified Imperial Knight 1|three]] [[Unidentified Imperial Knight 2|other]] [[Unidentified short-haired Imperial Knight|Knights]] and stand by the double's side at the meeting in an effort to promote the deception.<ref name="Legacy 8" />

The [[Human/Legends|Human]] dressed in the Emperor's robes and sat on his throne in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|New Imperial Palace]]. He was flanked by four Imperial Knight [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] as the six Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] of the council appeared before him. After [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Morlish Veed]] proclaimed that the galaxy now belonged to the Empire, [[Darth Krayt]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], arrived with three of his fellow [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]]: [[Darth Maladi]], [[Darth Nihl]], and [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]]. The double thanked them for their assistance in the war and asked Krayt what reward he desired&mdash;the Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] named the Emperor's life. Mohrgan called on his Imperial Knights to defend their "Emperor," but Krayt drew [[Jar'Kai/Legends|two]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and quickly [[Attack on Emperor Fel|slew]] them all despite their attempts at a defense. He then [[Death/Legends|struck]] down Fel's double, demanded the allegiance of the Moffs, and declared himself the Emperor of a [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|new Empire]].<ref name="Legacy 1" />

As the Emperor was himself a fully-trained Imperial Knight, the double's failure to defend himself tipped Krayt off that he was an impostor.<ref name="Legacy 1" /> However, the Dark Lord's epiphany came too late; the double's sacrifice allowed Fel to flee into [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]].<ref name="Legacy 8" /> The Emperor was able to secure forces loyal to him and form a [[Empire-in-exile|new Empire]], and he launched guerrilla strikes on Krayt's Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] for seven years. In [[137 ABY]], Fel [[Fall of Bastion|retook]] Bastion and became a serious threat to Krayt's galactic rule.<ref name="Legacy 3">[[Legacy (2006) 3|''Legacy'' (2006) 3]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|He was a double! The real Roan Fel could have resisted!|Darth Krayt belatedly realizes the double's deception|<ref name="Legacy 1" />}}
[[File:DeathofFelDecoy-2006Legacy1.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The double is killed by Darth Krayt.]]
The double of Roan Fel served the Emperor as a nearly identical lookalike<ref name="Legacy 8" /> for security reasons.<ref name="CSWE" /> Like Fel, the double had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] with a white streak, blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and a light skin tone.<ref name="Legacy 1" /> He attended a meeting of the Council of Moffs in the Emperor's stead after it was discovered that [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Krayt would attempt to kill Fel,<ref name="Legacy 8" /> and he was unable to defend himself from Krayt's attack.<ref name="Legacy 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The double of Roan Fel was created by [[John Ostrander]] and [[Jan Duursema]] for the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''. He first appeared and subsequently died in the series' [[Legacy (2006) 1|first issue]],<ref name="Legacy 1" /> released on [[June 21]], [[2006]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54719/star_wars_legacy_2006_1|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #1}}</ref> Fel himself had been pictured and given a brief biography in the preview issue [[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]], released earlier in the month.<ref name="Legacy 0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref> [[Dark Horse Comics]]' solicitation for the first issue stated that "An Emperor is betrayed,"<ref name="solicitation">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/13-453/Star-Wars-Legacy-1|text=Star Wars: Legacy #1}}</ref> and the comic did not clearly indicate that the person killed by Krayt was not in fact Fel until its penultimate page.<ref name="Legacy 1" />

The events surrounding the double's death were retold from different perspectives in ''Legacy''{{'s}} [[Legacy (2006) 8|eighth issue]] ([[2007]]), which also showed Roan and Mohrgan Fel devising the deception beforehand.<ref name="Legacy 8" /> Since then, the double has been mentioned in Roan Fel's entry in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and in [[2009]]'s ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''.<ref name="CSWE" /><ref name="LECG" /> Despite the double's failure to defend himself from Darth Krayt, [[Randy Stradley]], Dark Horse's Vice President of Publishing, has speculated that the character could possibly be an Imperial Knight.<ref name="Stradley">{{DHBoards|url=viewtopic.php?p=157364&sid=195782349dda1f46a2af59f1f2706520|thread=LEGACY: What's up with the Imperial Knights?|user=[[Randy Stradley]]|date=2007-06-06|time=08:23|quote=There could have been a re-think since this was stated, but originally John and Jan had decided that there were only about a dozen Imperial Knights. Whether they've been able to train replacements for the four (five, if the Fel impersonator was also a Knight) who were killed in issue #1 in the seven intervening years remains to be seen.}}</ref>
